Admin.title: Admin console
Admin.lede: Reports, reviews, data jobs, the funnel and the taxonomy. Every action is logged.

reports.title: Reports
reports.noteHint: Visible to admins only. At least 3 characters.
reports.suspendConfirm: Pause {name} from matching for 30 days? Booked chats are not cancelled automatically.
reports.studentSuspendNote: Student accounts are paused from the account page in production; here, resolve with a note.

review.title: Practitioner review
review.lede: People who signed up with a personal email. Check that the profile matches the job they list.
review.rejectBody: They can try again with a work email. Say briefly why — they’ll see this.

pipeline.title: Pipeline runs
pipeline.lede: Latest run per job. Failed runs are listed first and would email the team.
pipeline.failedTitle: {n, plural, one {# job failed} other {# jobs failed}} on its last run
pipeline.failedBody: Numbers from that source may be out of date. Re-run, or check the error below.

metrics.title: Funnel and North Star
metrics.lede: Computed from requests and their events. Rates show numerator and denominator.
metrics.small: Small numbers — fewer than {n} observations, so treat this as anecdotal.
metrics.northStarDef: Students who completed a signal → request → chat loop in the last 7 days (PRD §4.2).
metrics.createdDef: All requests, including ones we passed on automatically ({student} sent by students).
metrics.acceptedDef: Requests accepted within 72 hours of being sent, out of requests that have had 72 hours or were answered. Target ≥ 50%.
metrics.completedDef: Both sides confirmed, or one did and the other stayed silent for 7 days.
metrics.debriefedDef: Completed chats with an L0 vote. Target ≥ 60%.
metrics.attendanceDef: Completed chats out of completed + no-show. Target ≥ 85%.
metrics.supplyDef: Verified, not paused or suspended, under their cap, with an open time ≥ 48h ahead. Target ≥ 30.
metrics.waitlistDef: Students waiting for someone with a skill to open times.

taxonomy.title: Aliases
taxonomy.lede: What people type → which skill or role it means. Search uses these (FR-D6).
taxonomy.aliasHint: Lowercase, as people type it. e.g. “k8s”, “postgres”.
